card.title: How To Repair DualSense 5 Controller Stick Drift Issue

source.title: How To Repair DualSense 5 Controller Stick Drift Issue

claims.statement: DualSense drift: slight or intermittent drift often means contamination; strong constant drift in one direction means a worn potentiometer; drift on both axes means module failure.
Reset (rear pin 5–10 s) and update firmware first; cleaning with 90%+ IPA is a temporary fix, replacing the joystick module (OEM or Hall-effect) is the permanent one.

procedure: Confirm drift in a tester (e.g. ds.daidr.me).
Clean the stick base with IPA for minor drift.
Desolder (add low-melt solder) and replace the joystick module.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
